scope: Source-attributed official PIB article relevance, multilabel event type, exact evidence spans, and date-role extraction. No price forecast or causal price effect is evaluated.

identity.article_key: source organization + immutable source identifier (PIB PRID); exact source URL when no identifier exists
identity.duplicate_grouping: All revisions of one article key remain in one group. Exact body hashes group identical bodies. Near-identical normalized bodies with five-word-shingle Jaccard similarity >= 0.90 share an evaluation group. Grouping does not merge or delete source records.

availability.system_available_at: first_seen_at_utc for earliest genuine local capture; manual import time is not publication time
availability.publication_time: Use only source-reported precision; date-only remains date-only and an unsupplied timezone remains unknown
availability.historical_backtests: Never expose an article as a feature before its first-seen timestamp, regardless of its historical publication date

event_review_labels: zero or more categories from the checked-in EVENT_TAXONOMY
normalized date plus semantic date role where supported
exclusions: near-duplicate group leakage across any future split

current_partition.validation: none; no human-reviewed gold labels exist
current_partition.test_rule: Only articles first captured at or after the test start may enter a future test. Keep full duplicate/revision groups intact. Hide test labels from rule/model edits until the evaluation is reported. Any classifier, taxonomy, feature, or threshold change after viewing test outcomes invalidates that test and requires a new future cutoff.

metrics: article relevance precision/recall/F1 with confusion counts
event-category micro and supported per-category scores
exact normalized date and role precision/recall/F1
limitations: Keyword rules are experimental. No human labels, model training, calibration, validation, or accuracy claims are present in this protocol's current dataset.
